118272.name: Chabad of Park Slope
118272.note: Its own site: founded by Rabbi Shimon and Sarah Hecht in 1987; another feature has them moving to Park Slope in 1987 with two small children. Medium: a Chabad feature says they moved there in 1986 (read through search summaries; the site doesn't answer plain requests). Rabbi Hecht leads Congregation B'nai Jacob, 401 9th St.

118339.name: Chabad of Rego Park
118339.note: The Queens Jewish Link: Chabad of Rego Park, 'run by Rabbi Eli and Shulamis Blokh, began operations in 1997 as a means to provide the growing Russian Jewish community of the area with a much-needed infusion of Judaism'; another QJL report: the Torah procession started 'from where the Chabad of Rego Park first began in 1997, at the Blokhs' home'.

364555.name: Chabad of Little Neck
364555.note: The Queens Chronicle/QNS (29 Sept 2008): the Shifrins 'moved to Little Neck in the fall of 2005'; 'her husband delivered services to seven people at their first High Holiday services in 2005'. At 254-05 Cullman Ave.

262258.name: Chabad of Kings Highway
262258.note: Lubavitch.com (on COLlive, 8 Jan 2012, 'Flatbush Jews Have a Center'): 'Chabad of Kings Highway opened its doors in 2006', run by Rabbi Zalman Drizin. Medium: its chabad.org listing went up Feb 20 2005, so the work may have begun in 2005, before the doors opened.

117680.name: Chabad Lubavitch of West Brighton
117680.note: Anash.org: 'Rabbi Zushe Winner Shlita was appointed by Tzach Hamerkozis on January 8, 1991 to serve the community of West Brighton.' (COLlive: rabbi of the Sea Breeze Jewish Center in West Brighton; founder of Chabad Neshama.)

314172.name: Chabad of Harlem
314172.note: Chabad.org (on CrownHeights.info, 3 March 2013, Rabbi Shaya Gansbourg's obituary): 'In 2005, they hosted Chabad's first communal Passover seder in Harlem'; Chabad.org elsewhere: Chabad 'first took root in Harlem in 2005'. The NY Daily News (on CrownHeights.info, 15 Sept 2008): the center he and his wife, Goldie, 'opened last year' (2007, the storefront). Their son Rabbi Yossel Gansbourg leads it now.

398217.name: Chabad of the Lower East Side
398217.note: Its own About page: 'Following his marriage to Chani in 2001, the couple enlisted as permanent emissaries of the Rebbe and settled on the Lower East Side of Manhattan in 2004'; 'Since 2004, Rabbi Yisrael and Chani ... have been dedicated to building a warm, welcoming Jewish community on the Lower East Side' (read through a search summary; a Chabad.org profile gives the same year). Its listing went up July 2 2006.
